properties.name: Caesarea Philippi
properties.description: Where Peter confessed 'You are the Christ' near the springs of Mount Hermon.

properties.name: Caesarea Maritima
properties.description: Roman capital of Judea where Cornelius was baptized and Paul was imprisoned.
properties.photo_caption: panorama of ruins at Caesarea Maritima

photos.caption: panorama of ruins at Caesarea Maritima

properties.name: Hebron
properties.description: Cave of the Patriarchs (burial of Abraham, Sarah, Isaac, Jacob); David's first capital.

photos.caption: building at the Cave of the Patriarchs
cityscape of Hebron in the Valley of Hebron

properties.name: Shechem / Sychar
properties.biblical_region: Samaria between Mt Ebal & Mt Gerizim
properties.description: Abraham's first altar in Canaan; Jacob's Well where Jesus spoke with the Samaritan woman.

properties.name: Mount Carmel
properties.description: Site of Elijah's confrontation with the 450 prophets of Baal.

photos.caption: panorama of part of Mount Carmel

properties.name: Mount Sinai
properties.description: Where God gave Moses the Ten Commandments and the Law; Elijah later sheltered here.

properties.name: Antioch (Syria)
properties.description: First place believers were called 'Christians'; launching point for Paul's missionary journeys.
properties.photo_caption: building at Antioch on the Orontes

photos.caption: building at Antioch on the Orontes
map of Antioch on the Orontes

properties.name: Damascus
properties.description: Site of Saul's conversion on the road to Damascus and the 'Street Called Straight'.

photos.caption: panorama of cliffs in the region between Damascus and Hamath
cityscape along the Tora River, which runs underground here

properties.name: Ephesus
properties.description: Metropolis of Asia Minor; site of Paul's 3-year ministry and John's exile home.

properties.name: Athens
properties.description: Philosophical capital of Greece; Paul addressed philosophers on Mars Hill (Areopagus).
properties.photo_caption: panorama of the acropolis at Athens

photos.caption: panorama of the acropolis at Athens
panorama of the acropolis at Athens

properties.name: Corinth
properties.description: Major maritime center; Paul stayed 18 months planting the church and writing letters.

properties.name: Rome
properties.description: Capital of the Roman Empire; Paul's imprisonment, ministry, and eventual martyrdom alongside Peter.

properties.name: Babylon
properties.description: Capital of the Neo-Babylonian Empire; destination of Judah's exile under Nebuchadnezzar; home of Daniel.

properties.name: Ur of the Chaldees
properties.description: Ancestral homeland of Abraham from which God called him to travel to the Promised Land.

properties.name: Nineveh
properties.description: Great capital of the Assyrian Empire to which the prophet Jonah was sent to preach repentance.

properties.name: Joppa
properties.description: Port where Jonah fled to Tarshish; Peter had his vision of clean/unclean animals at Simon the Tanner's house.

properties.name: Emmaus
properties.description: Seven miles from Jerusalem where the risen Jesus walked with two disciples and broke bread.
